In the fifteenth year, Zhao Weichong, military governor of Goryeo's Western Capital, rebelled against Hao and sent Xu Yan and ninety-six others with a memorial, saying, "The former king did not in fact abdicate; Grand General Zheng Chongfu and Colonel Li Yifang actually assassinated him.

In the fifteenth year, Zhao Weichong, military governor of Goryeo's Western Capital, rebelled against Hao and sent Xu Yan and ninety-five others with a memorial, saying, "The former king did not in fact abdicate; Grand General Zheng Chongfu and Colonel Li Yifang actually assassinated him.
Chinese 徐彥等九十六人 means Xu Yan and company totaling 96; literal's 'ninety-six others' overcounts by one.

Soon Hao suppressed Zhao Weichong's revolt and sent envoys with thanks. He also reported that since the rebellion his birthday, return-thanks, New Year's, tribute, and Ten Thousand Springs missions had all been blocked—he now listed them together.

Soon Hao suppressed Zhao Weichong's revolt and sent envoys with thanks. He also reported that since the rebellion his birthday return-thanks, transverse-bestowal return-thanks, New Year's, tribute, and Ten Thousand Springs missions had all been blocked—he now listed them together.
Idiomatic omits 橫賜回謝 (transverse-bestowal return-thanks), which the Chinese and literal both retain.

In the twelfth month officials reported that during the lower festival Goryeo's horse-escort officer Shunchengwei had led three armed men across the border. Though the offense was serious, the emperor ordered only their repatriation.

In the twelfth month officials reported that during the lower festival Goryeo's horse-escort officer Shuncheng had exceptionally led three armed men across the border. Though the offense was serious, the emperor ordered only their repatriation.
English fuses 順成 with following 例外 into the false name Shunchengwei; 順成 is the officer's name and 例外 means against regulation/exceptionally.

In the twelfth month, the relevant offices reported that during the lower festival, the horse-escort officer Shunchengwei led three armored men across the border in violation of regulations. The emperor considered the envoy's offense grave but ordered only that they be sent back to their own country.

In the twelfth month, the relevant offices reported that during the lower festival, the horse-escort officer Shuncheng exceptionally led three armored men across the border in violation of regulations. The emperor considered the envoy's offense grave but ordered only that they be sent back to their own country.
Literal likewise invents the fused personal name Shunchengwei from 順成例外.
In the eighth month of Zhiyuan 1 King Ting died before his heir had completed the mourning resumption rites.
In the eighth month of Zhining 1 King Ting died before his heir had completed the mourning resumption rites.
Chinese 至甯 is the Jin reign Zhining (AD 1213), not Zhiyuan; the idiomatic reign name is wrong.
In the eighth month of the first year of Zhiyuan, King Ting died; the heir had not yet undertaken the resumption of mourning duties.
In the eighth month of the first year of Zhining, King Ting died; the heir had not yet undertaken the resumption of mourning duties.
Literal also renders 至甯 as Zhiyuan instead of Zhining.
